Their omission is not a defect, and the producer's 'disputed' marking is correct.

reasoning: Held text (40 FR 1217) read in full. The 15 clauses cover Sec. 1 (with items (1) to (5) under one span, as disclosed), items (6) to (11), Sec. 2 and its items, Sec. 3 and Sec. 4. The number hits are only EO 11915 and 11948. Savings rightly rest on the establishing orders and EO 11948.
